property_summary: For any of the three configured roles (TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE), getRoleAdmin must return the stored TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE set in the constructor, but the mutant returns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead, so the rule breaks for PROPOSER_ROLE and EXECUTOR_ROLE.
change_summary: Return the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant instead of the stored adminRole for the role.
